lines.vo: Your first few weeks of strength gains are mostly not new muscle.
That's not fake progress. That's your brain learning to lift.
Dre logs his squats in his Fit and Strong Tracker, and the numbers climb before the mirror changes.
lines.cap: Dre logs his squats in his Fit & Strong Tracker, and the numbers climb before the mirror changes.

lines.vo: Early on, your nervous system learns to switch on more muscle fibers, and fire them together.
In a classic study, most of the early gains came from these nerve changes.
Visible muscle growth usually takes longer, often several weeks or more.
So if the mirror looks the same in week three, you're not failing. You're wiring up.
Watch the numbers, not the mirror. That's how you stay on track.
